title: protium fragrans
intro: Protium fragrans, commonly known as elemi, is a plant species native to the tropical forests of the Philippines and other parts of Southeast Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The health benefits of Protium fragrans are attributed to its ability to relieve coughs, colds, and other respiratory issues, while its bioactive constituents, including elemol, elemicin, and other terpenes, contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. Additionally, Protium fragrans has been used in traditional medicine to treat skin conditions, wounds, and other infections due to its antimicrobial and antiseptic properties.
